_meta.description: Mapeo package → categoría + señales para el sistema heurístico de dev-intelligence

openai.note: Presence implies active LLM spend. Rate limit pain is common.

litellm.note: Using LiteLLM = actively managing multi-provider cost/reliability

ollama.note: Local inference, privacy or cost concern

ai.note: Vercel AI SDK — implies production web product

langchain.note: Python. Core agent framework adoption signal.

@langchain/core.note: TypeScript. More mature than base langchain import.

crewai.note: Multi-agent coordination. High signal for agent builders hitting complexity ceiling.

pydantic-ai.note: Type-safe agent framework, high maturity signal

instructor.note: Structured LLM output — production discipline signal

playwright.note: CRITICAL: only count if in dependencies, NOT devDependencies. In devDeps = testing only.

@playwright/test.note: E2E testing framework — maturity signal only

puppeteer.note: Older than playwright, legacy automation signal

selenium-webdriver.note: Legacy stack — often looking to migrate

stagehand.note: AI-powered browser automation — hot ecosystem signal

msw.note: Mock Service Worker — API-aware testing discipline

testcontainers.note: Integration testing with real services — high maturity

stripe.note: Has paying customers. Strong buying intent signal.

@stripe/stripe-js.note: Frontend Stripe — implies full payment flow

clerk.note: Managed auth = paying for infra, production mindset

@supabase/supabase-js.note: Indie-stack signal. Auth + DB + Storage in one.

bullmq.note: STRONG scaling signal. Adding bullmq = hitting async processing limits.

redis.note: STRONG scaling signal. Adding Redis = caching or session management need.

@sentry/node.note: Has production users if using Sentry

resend.note: Modern transactional email = product has users

nodemailer.note: Most popular Node.js email library — app sends emails to real users

postmark.note: Postmark = paid transactional email, confirmed spend

mailtrap.note: Email testing tool — dev is already solving email QA, evaluating alternatives

mailhog.note: MailHog local SMTP catcher — dev tests email flows, needs disposable inboxes

nodemailer-mock.note: Nodemailer mock for tests — confirms email flows in codebase

ethereal.note: Ethereal fake SMTP — testing email without real delivery

docker.note: Check for Dockerfile presence, not this package

@modelcontextprotocol/sdk.note: TIER 1 ecosystem signal. Building MCP tooling.

pinecone-client.note: Managed vector DB = paying for AI infra

playwright-extra.note: Plugin layer over Playwright; indicates anti-detection needs.

rebrowser-playwright.note: Patched Playwright fork for bot detection bypass.

pyautogui.note: Desktop GUI automation; often used in RPA workflows.

nock.note: HTTP mocking library for Node.js tests.

k6.note: Load testing; scaling signal when present.

multion.note: MultiOn SDK — paid browser agent API.

dendrite.note: Browser automation framework for AI agents.

beautifulsoup4.note: HTML parsing; common in scraping stacks.

supabase.note: Hosted Postgres + auth + storage; scaling signal at volume.

@firebase/auth.note: Firebase Auth — real auth layer (not just JWT).

auth0.note: Auth0 SDK — paid at scale; serious auth signal.

tortoise-orm.note: Async ORM for Python; signals production API.

@vercel/postgres.note: Vercel Postgres — tied to Vercel platform spend.

@trigger.dev/sdk.note: Trigger.dev job scheduler; production workflow signal.

temporalio.note: Temporal workflow engine — strong production signal.

datadog-lambda.note: Datadog Lambda layer — confirmed infra spend.

plausible.note: Privacy-focused analytics; signals product with web presence.

hotjar.note: Hotjar session recording — confirmed paid product.

pulumi.note: Pulumi IaC — Python/TS infra as code.

elasticsearch.note: Elasticsearch client — implies search infra investment.
